best_idea: Redraw only changed cells: keep per-row dirty bounds and a changed flag, draw inside the bounds, then clear them.
decision_why: Bounds-then-flag redraw is a small proven way to keep a minimap or HUD cheap on a phone; the row-span visibility needs a corner test before use, and the tty-specific parts are rejected.
acceptance: With the hero still for 60 frames the minimap issues zero draw calls per frame; when one tile changes exactly one draw call is issued in that frame; a test checks the dirty bounds are empty after each flush.
